title: Genotype-phenotype links (flying fish)
headline: Closed (stale, no update since 2026-10-31T22:27:43.774Z). An annotated flying-fish genome exists (23,611 predicted genes), so the gap is not missing genes but missing expression and phenotype records, which exist only for zebrafish and medaka: every gene link here is proxy-fish data for that reason. Of 92 experimentally shown interventions on fin and body shape, only 12 carry a true effect magnitude together with the stage it was measured at, and pectoral fin LENGTH has no calibrated route at all. Of 42 gene-to-phenotype chains, 29 have a weakest link of necessity or better and 38 hold at least one mechanism-grade link. The best single lever to a bigger fin, hhip loss of function at +65% area, enlarges the pectoral fin by disorganising the rest of the skeleton.
